fields.meta_title: Delivery Receipt Form Template With Signatures | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a delivery receipt form template that records ordered and delivered counts, takes a customer signature, and saves every receipt.
fields.h1: Build a Delivery Receipt Form Template Signed at the Door
fields.hero_description: Build a delivery receipt form template that logs what arrived, takes a signature, and flags short or damaged lines.
fields.features_heading: What the Form Does From Truck to Office
fields.features_subheading: A carbon receipt book rides in the cab for a week. This form puts each signed receipt in front of the office the same day.
fields.feature_1:
Describe your stops, get the form

Tell Emergent what your drivers carry and what the office needs back. Emergent builds the phone form, the receipts table, and the office view, and changes them on request.
fields.feature_2:
Ordered and delivered on every line

Each line shows the quantity ordered next to a box for the quantity delivered. When the two numbers differ, the app marks the line short or over and asks for a reason.
fields.feature_3:
The customer signs on the driver's phone

The person receiving the goods signs with a finger on the screen and types their printed name under it. The app stores the signature with the stop's date and the driver's name.
fields.feature_4:
A photo for any damaged line

Choosing Damaged on a line opens a required photo field and a short note. The driver can't submit without the photo, and the office sees the dent the customer pointed at.
fields.feature_5:
A numbered copy for the customer

Each submitted receipt takes the next number in your series, such as DR-30415. The app then emails the customer a copy with every line, the signature, and any photos.
fields.feature_6:
Short and damaged lines reach a person

Pick who hears about each exception and where. A shortage can email the sales office, and a damage report can post to a Slack channel with the driver's photo attached.

fields.tab_content_1:
Of 40 cases ordered, 38 signed for and 2 credited

Grindlow Foods drivers carry a phone on every restaurant route. At Stilwater Diner, the driver enters 38 cases delivered against 40 ordered, and Gwenna Reyhill signs for them. The 2 short cases of tomatoes reach the sales office as an emailed credit request.
fields.tab_content_2:
The torn seam is in the photos before Clio signs

Clio Esmond ordered a sofa and 2 end tables from Ashlund Furniture. When the crew unwraps the sofa, she points to a torn seam on the back cushion. The crew marks the sofa Damaged and takes the photo, then Clio signs. Customer service sees the photo in Slack before the truck reaches its next stop.
fields.tab_content_3:
On a PO for 24 cartons, the dock counts 26

Purchase order 4471 called for 24 cartons of fasteners at Tavistoke Hardware. Torvin Ingold photographs the packing slip at the dock, and the app reads the supplier, PO number, and carton count into fields. He counts 26 on the pallet, and purchasing gets an email about the 2 extra cartons.
fields.tab_content_4:
Disputed 19 days later, the receipt is one search away

Quarlby Print Shop emails Okebridge Office Supply to say 4 boxes of toner never arrived. Billing searches the receipts table for the shop's name and opens DR-30962 from 19 days earlier. It holds Eluned Coldfield's signature and the driver's photo of the boxes in the doorway.

fields.howto_title: How to Make a Delivery Receipt Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to plan a delivery receipt form template drivers can finish at the door, then build it with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Put a name next to each reason
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Set the receipt number and the copy
fields.howto_step_1_des: Write down what you deliver and the unit you count it in: cases, cartons, pieces, or pallets. Use the unit the order uses, or the ordered and delivered numbers won't line up.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Choose the reasons a driver can give when a line doesn't match: short, over, damaged, or refused. Keep the list small enough to read on a phone in a loading zone.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Write down the person who acts on each exception reason and what they do next. If nobody acts on a reason, cut it from the list before you build.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Choose a prefix and a starting number for your receipts. Then decide what the customer's emailed copy shows, such as the lines and the signature, and whether photos go with it.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Describe the stops your drivers make, the fields on each line, and the rules you wrote down above. Emergent builds it from that prompt, and you adjust any rule by prompting again.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Run one stop on a real phone
fields.howto_step_6_des: Fill one receipt standing in a parking lot, the way a driver would. Mark one line short and another damaged, then confirm both alerts arrive and the photo opens.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Search the receipts table for your test customer and open the receipt. Confirm the signature and the counts match what you entered, then delete the test row before launch.

faq_plan.q: What is a delivery receipt form template?
faq_plan.a: A delivery receipt form template is a reusable form that records what was delivered, to whom, and when, signed by whoever accepts the goods. Each copy lists the items with the quantities ordered and delivered. The seller and the customer then hold the same record of the drop.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a delivery receipt form template?
faq_plan.a: Start by listing the items you deliver, the reasons a line can fail to match, and who follows up on each one. Then describe the form in plain English to Emergent's AI form builder, and it builds the driver's form, the place receipts are saved, and the alerts. Test one stop on a phone before your drivers use it.

faq_plan.q: Who gets a copy of a signed delivery receipt form template?
faq_plan.a: Both sides do: the seller keeps the signed receipt with the order, and the customer gets a copy with the same lines and signature. Send the customer's copy when the driver submits, and let the office resend it from the saved receipts if the customer asks weeks later.

faq_plan.q: How is a delivery receipt form template different from a payment receipt?
faq_plan.a: A delivery receipt confirms that goods arrived and who accepted them; a payment receipt confirms that money changed hands. One order can have both, issued on different days. A nonprofit's donation receipt form is a third kind, written to acknowledge a gift.

faq_plan.q: How does a delivery receipt form template handle a partial or refused delivery?
faq_plan.a: Give every line its own status, such as delivered, short, damaged, or refused, instead of one status for the whole receipt. The customer then signs for what arrived, and each refused or missing line keeps its own reason and quantity for the office to follow up.

faq_plan.q: Can a delivery receipt form template take the customer's signature on a phone?
faq_plan.a: Yes. The customer draws a signature on the driver's screen and types a printed name under it. In the app Emergent builds, each signed receipt is stored in a database you own, and the signature stays attached to the order record.

faq_plan.q: Which fields should be required on a delivery receipt form template?
faq_plan.a: Require the fields the office can't work without: the customer, the delivered quantity on each line, and the receiver's printed name and signature. Make the rest conditional on the answers that need them. A damaged line can require a photo and a short line a reason, while a clean delivery stays at a few taps.

faq_plan.q: Can a delivery receipt form template fill in from a photo of the packing slip?
faq_plan.a: Yes, for the fields printed on the slip. The app reads the order number and the quantities into fields, and any field it reads with low confidence goes to a person to confirm. The receiver still counts what is on the pallet, since the slip shows what was shipped, not what arrived.

faq_plan.q: Can a delivery receipt form template update inventory or accounting records?
faq_plan.a: Yes, if the system you use has an API. Apps built with Emergent connect to tools such as QuickBooks or Xero. A signed receipt can then mark an order delivered or start a credit for a short line. Decide which system owns each record before you connect them.

faq_plan.q: How should a delivery receipt form template number each receipt?
faq_plan.a: Use a short prefix and a sequence that only goes up, such as DR followed by five digits. The app gives each submitted receipt the next number. A gap in the series then points to a receipt that was started and never sent. Keep the same prefix on the customer's copy and in your records.
